## Change Description

What does this PR address or introduce? Link any relevant issues.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix: ...`)
- [ ] New feature / widget (`feat: ...`)
- [ ] Documentation / tooling (`chore: ...` or `docs: ...`)
- [ ] Refactoring / performance improvement (`refactor: ...`)

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] `bun run lint` passes with 0 errors and 0 warnings
- [ ] `bun test` passes (all unit and integration tests)
- [ ] `bun run build` succeeds
- [ ] Verified piped execution with sample Antigravity telemetry
- [ ] No private credentials, personal file paths, or sensitive transcripts included
